battle.name: 沙特阿拉伯統一戰爭
battle.brief: 沙特阿拉伯統一戰爭始於1902年，戰事遍及阿拉伯半島的內志與希賈茲，阿卜杜勒阿齊茲率領部眾逐步奪取利雅得及希賈茲要地，推動沙特政權擴張。英軍的恩菲爾德步槍（Enfield rifle）於1858年列裝，是當時制式步槍，可支援步兵線列作戰與中遠距程射擊。

kit.name: 恩菲爾德步槍
kit.history: 恩菲爾德步槍是英國陸軍的制式栓動後膛步槍，列為標準步兵武器，負責中遠距程射擊，並構成19世紀末至20世紀初英軍步兵裝備體系的核心。

countries: 1902年的「沙特阿拉伯統一戰爭」，按通常史料用語，是阿卜杜勒阿齊茲·本·穆罕默德·本·阿卜杜勒拉赫曼·阿爾沙特率第一沙特政權軍隊奪取利雅得、擊破第二沙特政權在奈季德核心抵抗之役。戰場是今沙烏地阿拉伯首都利雅得及其東南郊區，進攻方向由卡爾季、瓦迪哈尼法一帶指向城內；它並非發生在已經成立的沙烏地阿拉伯王國。攻方是阿卜杜勒阿齊茲的沙烏地部族聯盟與其小型常戰骨幹，守方是利雅得總督阿卜杜拉·本·阿卜杜勒阿齊茲·阿爾沙特所率的埃米拉政府、城堡守軍及效忠的奈季德部族。英國提供過基地、軍械與訓練顧問，但沒有部隊參加利雅得交戰；鄂圖曼也沒有直接指揮攻守，因此兩國應列為外部政治因素，而非此役的交戰國。
countriesEn: The 1902 campaign usually meant by the term ‘Saudi unification war’ was the operation in which Abdulaziz bin Muhammad bin Abdulrahman Al Saud, leading the First Saudi State, seized Riyadh and broke the Second Saudi State’s resistance in the Najdi core. The battlefield was the present-day Saudi capital and its southeastern approaches, with the advance running from the direction of Al-Kharj and Wadi Hanifa into the city; it did not take place within an already established Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The attackers were Abdulaziz’s Saudi tribal confederation and its small permanent combat core. The defenders were the government of the Emirate of Riyadh under Governor Abdullah bin Abdulaziz Al Saud, the city’s garrison, and Najdi groups loyal to it. Britain supplied a base, matériel and training advice earlier, but no British troops fought at Riyadh. The Ottoman Empire likewise directed neither side in the city. Britain and the Ottomans were therefore external political factors rather than belligerents in this battle.
people: 阿卜杜勒阿齊茲是此次行動的指揮者，也是第一沙特政權在1902年的實際領袖。他自1894年起以科威特為基地，1899年重建沙烏地力量，先取烏海迪爾，1901年在穆巴拉茲戰役後控制哈薩；到利雅得決戰時，他已擁有由部族騎手、固定射手、堡壘人員和駱駝後勤組成的混合隊伍。他親自選定突擊時機、決定先攻蘇韋迪堡，並在堡壘得手後指揮向城內推進。其同父異母兄弟穆罕默德·本·阿卜杜拉·阿爾沙特是最可信的戰場副手之一，負責維持核心突擊隊的指揮與傳令；利雅得方面的阿卜杜拉·本·阿卜杜勒阿齊茲·阿爾沙特則組織城防、調集城堡守軍及部族援軍。兩位領袖之下仍有數名堡壘指揮官與部族首領，但現存資料沒有留下可靠而完整的指揮序列，因此不能為每座堡另編人數，也不能寫入未經證實的冒險細節。
peopleEn: Abdulaziz bin Muhammad Al Saud commanded the operation and was the effective leader of the First Saudi State in 1902. Beginning in 1894, he had used Kuwait as his base; in 1899 he rebuilt his Saudi force, took Al-Ukhaydir, and after the Battle of Mubarraz in 1901 he controlled Al-Ahsa. By the time he fought for Riyadh, his available force combined tribal horsemen, a smaller body of reliable riflemen, fortress personnel and camel-based logistics. He personally chose the moment of attack, selected Al-Suwaidi as the first objective and directed the advance into the city after its capture. His half-brother Muhammad bin Abdullah Al Saud was one of the best-attested field deputies, helping maintain command and communications within the striking force. On the other side, Abdullah bin Abdulaziz Al Saud organized the city’s defenses and drew on the castle garrisons and allied tribal contingents. Several fortress commanders and tribal leaders served under the opposing leaders, but the surviving record does not preserve a reliable complete order of battle, so no artificial command structure, troop allocation or unverified adventure should be added.
kits: 裝備不能按1930年代沙烏地軍的標準化序列倒填。就1902年前後可追溯的英國軍械供應及沙烏地早期部隊裝備而言，具體的步槍基線是英製Martini-Henry Mk III栓動步槍，採單發射擊，使用.577/450 Nitro Express彈藥；重機槍基線是Maxim Mk I水冷重機槍，使用.303 British彈藥並以彈鏈供彈。兩種型號在1902年以前均已正式列裝，不是後來武器。約四十人的突擊核心並不等於人人持有一支步槍，其餘人員仍依靠沙烏地式彎刀、坐騎和駱駝；Maxim重機槍與野戰砲屬於阿卜杜勒阿齊茲整支軍隊的火力架構，但現有戰況記述不足以證明每挺重機槍或每門砲都在蘇韋迪堡一線。利雅得城堡火砲的型號與口徑也沒有得到一致保存，因此不能套用另一場戰役的砲兵編制。英式步槍的備用彈藥通常由射手隨身攜帶，Maxim彈鏈及較重的軍械則由馱畜分載；彈藥主要經科威特與海灣商人渠道取得，飲水則沿途取自井水。當時沒有可依賴的鐵路、汽車、無線電或固定攻城鐵路。
kitsEn: The equipment cannot be reconstructed by projecting the standardized Saudi order of battle of the 1930s backward. For the British matériel supply and early Saudi equipment traceable around 1902, the specific rifle baseline was the British Martini-Henry Mk III bolt-action rifle. It fired single shots and used .577/450 Nitro Express ammunition. The heavy-machine-gun baseline was the Maxim Mk I water-cooled gun, chambered for .303 British ammunition and belt-fed. Both were real types formally fielded before 1902, not later inventions. A striking core of roughly forty men did not mean that every man carried a rifle; others depended on Saudi-style sabres, riding animals and camels. The Maxim guns and field artillery formed part of Abdulaziz’s wider army’s firepower structure, but the surviving descriptions of the fighting do not establish how many stood on the Al-Suwaidi front. The exact types and calibres of the artillery in the Riyadh forts have likewise not been preserved consistently, so an artillery organization belonging to another campaign cannot be substituted. Reserve Martini-Henry ammunition was carried individually by riflemen, while Maxim belts and heavier stores were divided among pack animals. Ammunition reached the army largely through Kuwaiti and Gulf merchant channels, while water was drawn from wells along the route. There was no usable railway, motor transport, wireless link or permanent siege railway.
tactics: 這是一場以小兵群奪取支點的奇襲，而不是依靠人數進行的正面攻城。阿卜杜勒阿齊茲以駱駝和坐騎保持機動，由內陸向利雅得東南接近；每日行程與確切出發時點雖未完整保存，但突擊是在黎明前發動，首要目標是控制瓦迪哈尼法入口的蘇韋迪堡。突擊隊沒有同時分兵挑戰多座城堡，而是把射擊火力集中於堡門、牆側及守軍所在位置，再以近戰壓力迫使守軍退入堡內。蘇韋迪堡得手後，阿卜杜勒阿齊茲立即派騎士控制鄰近道路、維持消息傳遞，並把奪得的堡壘當作向城內推進的支撐點，方向隨即轉向馬斯馬克及利雅得中心區。守軍曾由其他城堡和部族隊伍發動反擊，但指揮分散使各處難以同時支援，攻方則靠較集中的隊形保持連續推進。戰局沒有發展成長期圍城；堡壘控制權與城內政治中樞相繼轉移後，守方在失去有效協同的情況下接受投降或承認既成局勢。1901年穆巴拉茲戰役中以欺騙迫使守軍放棄堡壘的做法，不應移植到利雅得；此役較可靠的戰術核心是逼近、奇襲、奪取第一堡，再迅速轉向第二個關鍵目標。
tacticsEn: This was a surprise operation in which a small body seized decisive points, not a frontal siege decided by numbers. Abdulaziz maintained mobility with camels and riding animals while approaching Riyadh from the interior. Although the daily marches and exact departure times were not fully preserved, the assault began before dawn, with the first objective being Al-Suwaidi fort, which commanded the entrance to Wadi Hanifa. The attackers did not disperse to challenge several forts simultaneously. They concentrated rifle fire on the gate, the flanks and the positions occupied by the defenders, then applied close pressure to force the garrison inside. Once Al-Suwaidi had fallen, Abdulaziz immediately sent horsemen to control the adjoining roads, maintain communications and use the captured fort as the supporting point for an advance toward Al-Masmak and the centre of Riyadh. The defenders attempted counterattacks from other forts and with contingents supplied by allied tribes, but divided command made simultaneous support difficult. The attackers preserved concentration and continued their advance. The battle did not become a prolonged siege. As control of the forts and the political centre of the city changed hands, the defenders lost effective coordination and accepted surrender or the accomplished situation. The deception used against the garrison at Mubarraz in 1901 should not be transferred to Riyadh. The better-attested tactical sequence here was approach, surprise, seizure of the first fort and rapid transfer to the next key objective.
data: 可重建的時間線始於此前兩年：1899年，阿卜杜勒阿齊茲在烏海迪爾擊敗對手並恢復第一沙特政權的旗號；1901年，他在穆巴拉茲取勝後取得哈薩，得到東部的據點、收入與軍械來源。1902年初，其部隊由哈薩及卡爾季方向向利雅得集中，具體每日宿營點和里數未見完整記載。通行年表把突擊日定在1902年4月13日，通常對應回曆1319年Dhu al-Hijjah月28日；同日黎明前，隊伍攻擊蘇韋迪堡。4月14日仍見城堡周圍及通往城內各區的爭奪，防守方企圖集結反擊；至4月15日，利雅得的堡壘與政治控制已轉入阿卜杜勒阿齊茲之手。部分簡表只列4月13日，是因為只記錄攻擊開始，而非整個兩日戰鬥。突擊核心的人數常被記為約四十人，但這不是第一沙特政權全部軍隊的總數；守軍總數則沒有可靠而一致的數字。現有史料對死亡、重傷與被俘總數亦無一致記載，因此任何單一精確傷亡數字都不應被當作定論。能較穩定確認的結果是蘇韋迪堡首先易手，利雅得城防隨後瓦解，主要城堡的控制權與行政樞紐轉向阿卜杜勒阿齊茲。
dataEn: The recoverable chronology begins two years before the battle. In 1899, Abdulaziz defeated his opponent at Al-Ukhaydir and restored the flag of the First Saudi State. In 1901, victory at Mubarraz was followed by the capture of Al-Ahsa, giving him eastern bases, revenue and a source of weapons. In early 1902, his forces concentrated toward Riyadh from the direction of Al-Ahsa and Al-Kharj, although the daily camps and distances were not fully recorded. Standard chronologies date the assault to 13 April 1902, commonly corresponding to 28 Dhu al-Hijjah 1319; before dawn that day, the force attacked Al-Suwaidi fort. Fighting around the forts and the approaches into the city continued on 14 April as the defenders attempted to assemble a counterattack. By 15 April, control of Riyadh’s forts and political administration had passed to Abdulaziz. Some short chronologies list only 13 April because they record the opening assault rather than the full two-day struggle. The striking core is commonly given as about forty men, but this was not the total strength of the First Saudi State’s army. No reliable, consistent total is available for the defenders either. The surviving accounts do not agree on totals for deaths, wounds and captivity, so any single precise casualty figure should not be treated as settled. The more stable facts are that Al-Suwaidi changed hands first, the city’s defensive system then disintegrated, and control of the principal forts and the administrative centre ultimately passed to Abdulaziz.
cause: 直接原因在於利雅得仍是第二沙特政權在奈季德的核心，而阿卜杜勒阿齊茲所代表的沙烏地宗族要求奪回這一中心。較深層的背景可追溯至1818年第一沙特政權覆亡及1820年後第二沙特政權建立。1891年，第二沙特政權的軍隊打垮第一沙特政權餘部，穆罕默德·本·沙特去世後，其子阿卜杜勒阿齊茲退往科威特；1892年第二沙特政權的蘇阿德·本·阿卜杜勒阿齊茲被殺，奈季德的宗族與政治競爭更加分散。阿卜杜勒阿齊茲在科威特獲得落腳地、外來軍械與部分訓練支援，又利用英國與鄂圖曼在中東競爭的環境重新集結力量。1899年奪取烏海迪爾及1901年控制哈薩，使他具備進攻利雅得的資金、武器和補給條件。奪取利雅得既能消除第二沙特政權最後一個重要統治中心，也能讓第一沙特政權取得奈季德人口、稅收與政治正統性的核心。這項行動帶有明確的宗族復興與王權統一目標，但不宜倒套成二十世紀民族主義國家形成的運動；1902年的交戰仍由王朝合法性、部族盟約和地方控制所驅動。
causeEn: The immediate cause was that Riyadh remained the Second Saudi State’s principal centre in Najd, while the Saudi lineage represented by Abdulaziz sought to recover it. The deeper background reaches back to the destruction of the First Saudi State in 1818 and the establishment of the Second Saudi State after 1820. In 1891, the Second Saudi State’s forces defeated the remaining First Saudi State adherents. After the death of Muhammad bin Saud, his son Abdulaziz withdrew to Kuwait; when Saud bin Abdulaziz Al Saud was killed in 1892, Najdi political and tribal competition became still more fragmented. In Kuwait, Abdulaziz gained a place of refuge, access to foreign weapons and some training support, while the British-Ottoman rivalry in the region gave him room to rebuild a force. His capture of Al-Ukhaydir in 1899 and control of Al-Ahsa in 1901 provided the money, weapons and supply needed to attack Riyadh. Taking the city would remove the last major centre of government of the Second Saudi State and give the First Saudi State access to Najdi manpower, revenue and political legitimacy. The operation had a clear dynastic restoration and ruling-unification objective, but it should not be treated as an anachronistic twentieth-century nationalist movement. In 1902 it was driven by dynastic legitimacy, tribal alliances and local control.
impact: 利雅得的陷落使第二沙特政權失去首都、主要堡壘與在奈季德中央的行政樞紐，其原有統治集團不再是與阿卜杜勒阿齊茲抗衡的主要政治中心；第一沙特政權則獲得控制奈季德核心的關鍵位置。這次勝利改變了奈季德的力量平衡，使阿卜杜勒阿齊茲能以利雅得為基地徵集部族、徵收收入、整頓軍隊，並把哈薩的財源與利雅得的控制在同一政治框架內銜接。它也提高了阿卜杜勒阿齊茲在英國方面的戰略價值；1907年的英沙條約等外交安排，正是建立在1902年之後形成的既成實力上。可是，1902年並未完成今日沙烏地阿拉伯全部疆域的統一。希吉茲仍在漢志主持謝里夫政權，北奈季德尚有拉希迪勢力，阿西爾及部分東部地區也未納入第一沙特政權。海灣與阿拉伯半島的統一仍需經過1921年征服漢志、1926至1927年兼併阿西爾等戰役，直到1932年才正式宣告沙烏地阿拉伯王國成立。因此，1902年的核心影響是重定奈季德政治中心，而不是在一夜之間建立現代民族國家。
impactEn: The fall of Riyadh deprived the Second Saudi State of its capital, principal forts and administrative centre in central Najd, and its former governing group ceased to be the main political power capable of balancing Abdulaziz. The First Saudi State gained the essential position of controlling the Najdi core. The victory changed the balance of power in Najd, allowing Abdulaziz to use Riyadh as a base for recruiting tribal contingents, collecting revenue, reorganizing his forces and linking the resources of Al-Ahsa with the government of central Najd under one political framework. It also increased Abdulaziz’s strategic value to Britain, and later diplomatic arrangements such as the Anglo-Saudi treaty of 1907 rested on the established power that had emerged after 1902. Yet 1902 did not unite all the territory of the present Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The Sharifian government under Husayn still governed the Hejaz, the Rashidis retained positions in northern Najd, and neither Asir nor several eastern regions had been incorporated. The remaining unification required the conquest of the Hejaz in 1921, the annexation of Asir in 1926 and 1927, and the formal proclamation of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia in 1932. The principal impact of 1902 was therefore the relocation of the political centre of Najd, not the overnight creation of a modern nation-state.
result: 此役的直接結果是利雅得及蘇韋迪、馬斯馬克等關鍵堡壘落入阿卜杜勒阿齊茲控制，阿卜杜拉·本·阿卜杜勒阿齊茲所代表的利雅得政府失去城市與行政樞紐，部分成員撤往外地，守軍則在各處協同崩潰後陸續放下抵抗。阿卜杜勒阿齊茲能以利雅得為新中心重建第一沙特政權的統治、軍隊與後勤，這才是此次勝利的實質所在。戰役結果不宜以未經核實的死亡或被俘數字衡量；較可靠的判準是城市、堡壘、道路與政治命令均已轉換控制者。奪取利雅得並不等於所有奈季德部族、所有阿拉伯地區或整個沙烏地阿拉伯疆域當時都已統一。阿卜杜勒阿齊茲仍須面對拉希迪勢力、謝里夫家族、鄂圖曼的漢志影響及阿西爾等挑戰，戰爭也沒有在1902年結束。最終答案是：1902年4月的利雅得戰役以第一沙特政權控制奈季德首都告終，它成為日後完成阿拉伯半島沙烏地統一的最早關鍵步驟之一。
resultEn: The immediate result of the campaign was that Riyadh and the key fortifications at Al-Suwaidi, Al-Masmak and other positions passed under Abdulaziz’s control. The Riyadh government represented by Abdullah bin Abdulaziz lost the city and its administrative centre; some of its members withdrew, while garrison units and allied contingents surrendered in stages after their ability to coordinate broke down. Abdulaziz could use Riyadh as the new centre for rebuilding the government, army and supply system of the First Saudi State, and that was the substance of the victory. The result should not be measured by an unverified total of dead or captured; the sounder test is that the city, forts, roads and political authority had changed hands. Taking Riyadh did not mean that all Najdi tribes, all Arab regions or the entire territory of the present Kingdom of Saudi Arabia were united at that time. Abdulaziz still had to confront the Rashidis, the Sharifian family, the Ottoman influence in the Hejaz and the rulers of Asir, and the wars did not end in 1902. The final answer is therefore that the April 1902 battle for Riyadh ended with the First Saudi State in control of the Najdi capital, making it one of the earliest decisive steps toward the later Saudi unification of the Arabian Peninsula.
